name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data science/AI, Amplify Analytix for analytics) targeting financial services with GenAI-powered customer intelligence solutions. Their methodology centers on data-driven CX transformation for banking and insurance, leveraging predictive analytics and AI models to drive customer lifetime value. Delivery model combines consulting with proprietary analytics platforms, primarily serving EU and Indian markets with an emphasis on regulated industries.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta differentiates through deep dual-platform expertise in SAP and Qualtrics, focusing on embedding experience data directly into SAP operational workflows via SAP BTP. Their methodology emphasizes closing the gap between experience insights and operational action through AI-augmented analytics and agent-based automation. Thought leadership centers on enterprise use cases in manufacturing and financial services across DACH, with a delivery model that combines UX design, SAP integration consulting, and Qualtrics implementation. Their AI stance is pragmatic and enterprise-focused, leveraging AI agents within existing SAP infrastructure rather than standalone AI solutions.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics positions as the premier Qualtrics partner for GCC government and public sector CX transformation, with deep expertise in citizen experience measurement and maturity frameworks. Their methodology is grounded in national-level CX program design aligned to Vision 2030 and smart government agendas. Delivery model combines Qualtrics platform implementation with strategic consulting for large-scale government transformation programs. Thought leadership focuses on Arabic-English bilingual content addressing public sector CX benchmarking and digital service delivery optimization.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its global research infrastructure to deliver large-scale CX measurement and advisory services, with a methodology rooted in behavioral science, advanced analytics, and proprietary loyalty/satisfaction frameworks. Their AI approach centers on predictive CX modeling and automated insight generation within broader research programs. Delivery model is research-led consulting supported by Medallia technology partnerships for platform-based VoC programs. Thought leadership emphasizes ROI of experience, customer loyalty economics, and cross-industry benchmarking at global scale.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont positions as a specialized Qualtrics implementation and advisory partner with deep expertise in financial services and banking CX programs. Their methodology emphasizes experience orchestration, AI agent deployment, and closed-loop feedback systems within regulated enterprise environments. Thought leadership focuses on practical AI applications within Qualtrics ecosystems, including automated action workflows and predictive experience analytics. Delivery model is US-focused Qualtrics consulting with strong vertical specialization in banking, insurance, and financial services.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK/EU-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner historically focused on enterprise experience management program design and implementation. Their methodology has centered on strategic XM advisory, Qualtrics platform deployment, and program optimization for mid-to-large enterprises. The extended period of content inactivity makes it difficult to assess current AI stance or evolving delivery model. Previous thought leadership addressed Qualtrics best practices, survey design optimization, and employee experience program architecture.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap is a Spanish-origin CX and EX consulting firm operating across Spain and Latin America with a platform-agnostic, methodology-driven approach to experience transformation. Their thought leadership centers on customer journey mapping, employee experience design, and organizational change management as enablers of CX maturity. Delivery model is pure consulting without technology platform dependency, differentiating through proprietary journey mapping frameworks and change management expertise. AI messaging remains minimal compared to technology-led competitors, with focus on human-centered design and organizational transformation.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo positions as the leading CX consultancy across Iberoamerica with Qualtrics-certified operations spanning 15+ Spanish-speaking markets. Their methodology combines strategic CX advisory with Qualtrics platform implementation, focusing on VoC program design, digital experience optimization, and CX maturity assessment. Thought leadership addresses enterprise CX challenges in Spanish and Portuguese, with particular emphasis on financial services and telecommunications verticals. Delivery model blends regional consulting presence with centralized Qualtrics technical capabilities, offering scale across Latin America and Iberia.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital-native technology company with CX capabilities housed within its Connected Experiences Studio, one of many specialized studios. Their AI approach is enterprise-scale, emphasizing AI engineering, generative AI adoption, and AI-augmented digital transformation rather than CX-specific AI applications. Delivery model is large-scale technology consulting and engineering services with global delivery centers, competing more broadly with systems integrators than specialized CX firms. CX thought leadership is subsumed within the larger AI and digital transformation narrative, making it less visible as standalone CX expertise.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.

name: Acceleration Strategy
blog_profile: Acceleration Strategy is a Canada/US-based Qualtrics partner with strong post-X4 2026 momentum in AI-focused XM content. Their methodology centers on Qualtrics AI agent deployment, experience orchestration, and enterprise XM program optimization for mid-to-large organizations. Thought leadership is highly tactical, offering practical guidance on implementing new Qualtrics AI capabilities and translating platform features into business outcomes. Delivery model combines Qualtrics strategic advisory with hands-on implementation, positioning as a trusted translator between Qualtrics product innovation and enterprise adoption in North American markets.
